metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Home Assistant through @vortitron/home-assistant-mcp, from Vome.

plugins.name: vome-panes
plugins.description: All four Vome side panes in one install: automations, ESPHome, health score, and a working dashboard.

plugins.name: vome-automation
plugins.description: A side pane for the Home Assistant automation Claude is working on, with what a save changed and which steps the latest run took.

plugins.name: vome-connect
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to your Home Assistant through Vome's hosted MCP, with one key from the Vome app (no sign-up) or vome.io.

plugins.name: vome-esphome
plugins.description: A side pane for ESPHome: a map of the device from its YAML, and the build Claude is running as it happens.

plugins.name: vome-health
plugins.description: A side pane for your Home Assistant's health: Vome's score and what its check found, marked as Claude fixes it, re-scored with a roll and fireworks.

plugins.name: vome-dash
plugins.description: A Home Assistant dashboard in a side pane, working: live states, controls that switch and dim, cameras in half blocks, what Claude changes lit up.

plugins.name: dont-panic
plugins.description: Just for fun: a Guide-style pane with animated scenes and live, irreverent Guide entries on whatever the agent is doing, and doodles that evolve as you work.

plugins.name: vome-doom
plugins.description: house.wad in a pane: your Home Assistant home as a Doom level, in the terminal. Shoot a lamp and it turns off for real.
